Sandbox_ProjectTerm_HuntersEnabled_toolt: Allows a small percentage of newly loaded vanilla zombies to become machine hunters.
Sandbox_ProjectTerm_HunterChance_tooltip: Chance that each zombie becomes a hunter when it is created or reused. Default: 3%.
Sandbox_ProjectTerm_HunterDifficulty_too: Controls the extra durability applied to hunters.
Sandbox_ProjectTerm_RedOpticsEnabled_too: Adds a tiny client-side red light to nearby living hunters.
Sandbox_ProjectTerm_MaxActiveHunterLight: Caps simultaneous optic lights. The nearest hunters receive lights first; zero disables all hunter lights.
